name: pr-1946
title: PR #1946 + #2103 — a right angle at a named foot or crossing is marked, once, in the stated corner

cases.title: A height to a named foot shows its right-angle mark at D, toward C
cases.lookFor: One right-angle square at D, in the corner between DA and DC; it stays on the DC side after each «הציגו תצורה אחרת».

cases.title: Writing the side the other way round puts the mark toward B
cases.lookFor: One right-angle square at D, between DA and DB.

cases.title: The diagonals' crossing, named O, shows its right angle in the corner COD
cases.lookFor: One right-angle square at O, between OC and OD (plus the square's own corner marks, if any).

cases.title: 3-D: the same height draws its right-angle mark at D, toward C
cases.lookFor: One right-angle mark at D between DA and DC, on every configuration.

cases.title: 3-D: the named crossing's mark moves to the corner COD
cases.lookFor: One right-angle mark at O, between OC and OD.
cases.before: The mark at O sat in the corner COB.

cases.title: Rhombus: the named crossing marks COD, the letter clear of it
cases.lookFor: One square at O between OC and OD; the letter O beside it, not on it.

cases.title: Quadrilateral: the named crossing marks COD
cases.lookFor: One square at O between OC and OD.
